approach.name: Catalogue first
approach.description: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

pages.label: Announcement bar
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Offers and promises
sections.intent: Short monospace messages take turns: the current offer code, free delivery threshold, COD and easy returns. Each store swaps in its own lines, and shoppers learn the deal before they browse.
sections.layout: a slow edge-to-edge marquee between thick black rules

pages.label: Header
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Search-first header
sections.intent: Logo and a wide, heavy-bordered search box share the top row, because shoppers in a store that sells anything usually know what they want. Account and cart sit at the end. Top categories run as a menu row below. On phones it is a compact bar with search kept visible.
sections.layout: logo and a wide search on one row, the menu below

pages.label: Home
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Shop by category
sections.intent: The page opens straight on the catalogue. The store's biggest category gets one large boxed tile with a blunt monospace line and a shop link. The other categories fill smaller bordered tiles, so fashion, groceries or auto parts all work without a campaign.
sections.layout: bento grid with one large tile, thick borders between tiles

sections.label: Best sellers
sections.intent: The store's top-selling products, with price, rating, wishlist and quick add, so a returning shopper can reorder in seconds.
sections.layout: horizontal scroller with the next card peeking

sections.label: Today's deals
sections.intent: Live offers and coupon codes with a countdown to the end of the sale. It gives mid-tier shoppers a clear reason to buy now.
sections.layout: a band in the brand colour with light monospace text, the countdown set large

sections.label: Shop by need
sections.intent: Tabs named after the store's main categories, each showing a few of its products. A single store can move through its range without leaving the home page.
sections.layout: asymmetric 7/5 grid: tabbed product grid left, one featured product card right

sections.label: Brands we stock
sections.intent: Logos of the brands the store carries, each linking to its brand page, for shoppers who shop by brand name.
sections.layout: an edge-to-edge marquee strip of boxed logos

sections.label: New this week
sections.intent: Fresh arrivals beside one large product picture, so regulars see what has changed since their last visit.
sections.layout: a split with the picture bleeding off the edge, a stacked list of new products beside it

sections.label: Shoppers say
sections.intent: Three real reviews with stars and the product bought, quoted in monospace. A new store earns trust across India this way.
sections.layout: three equal columns with thin dividers

sections.label: Get offers first
sections.intent: A brief, warm invitation to join the list for deal alerts, with the store's promise line beside it.
sections.layout: a heading pinned beside the signup form, boxed in a thick border

pages.label: Product listing
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: All products
sections.intent: A title band with the result count and category chips, so shoppers can narrow a large mixed catalogue in one tap.
sections.layout: a slim band under a thick rule, chips in a wrapping row

sections.label: Filter and browse
sections.intent: Filters for price, brand, rating and availability beside the product grid, with sort on top. This is the working heart of the catalogue.
sections.layout: filters in a bordered column on the left, the grid on the right

sections.label: Our promise
sections.intent: Delivery across India, COD, easy returns and secure payment, shown after the grid to settle doubts before the cart.
sections.layout: three equal columns with thin dividers and icons

pages.label: Category pages
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Category heading
sections.intent: Breadcrumbs, the name from <Category> set huge in monospace with its product count, and the description beside it. Subcategories from <SubCategories> appear as boxed picture tiles below and hide when there are none.
sections.layout: two columns: oversized name left, description right, tiles in a row below

sections.label: Products in category
sections.intent: The <Category> products in a clean grid under a toolbar with the result count and sort. Filters open in a drawer so the grid stays wide.
sections.layout: a full-width toolbar strip over a four-column grid

sections.label: Questions and details
sections.intent: Common questions for <Category> from <CategoryFaqs> beside its longer copy from <SeoText>, quiet and easy to read. Each hides when empty.
sections.layout: two columns under a thin rule: accordion left, text right

pages.label: Brand pages
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: About the brand
sections.intent: Breadcrumbs, the logo and name from <Brand> in a heavy box beside its tagline, story, website and social links, so shoppers know who makes what they are buying.
sections.layout: the logo and words in two columns

sections.label: Brand products
sections.intent: Every product from <Brand>, with filters and sort beside the grid for brands with large ranges.
sections.layout: filters in a column on the left, the grid on the right

sections.label: More on the brand
sections.intent: Longer copy from <SeoText> for shoppers who want detail before buying. It hides when empty.
sections.layout: a centred narrow column with generous space

pages.label: Search results
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Your search
sections.intent: The term and result count from <SearchQuery> in a bold slim band with the search box to try again. Filters sit beside the matching products below.
sections.layout: a slim band over filters on the left and the grid on the right

sections.label: Try a category
sections.intent: The store's categories, for shoppers whose search came up short, so they keep browsing instead of leaving.
sections.layout: a horizontal scroller of boxed category cards with the next card peeking

pages.label: Product page
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Product and buying
sections.intent: The gallery beside a sticky buy box: title, rating, price with discount, variant picker, quantity, add to cart, buy now, wishlist and a pincode delivery check, which Indian shoppers expect.
sections.layout: gallery left, sticky buy box right, separated by a thick border

sections.label: Details and specs
sections.intent: Description and specifications in tabs. This suits clothes, gadgets or groceries alike.
sections.layout: a full-width tab strip over a single text column

sections.label: Customer reviews
sections.intent: Ratings and written reviews from buyers, to back up the decision.
sections.layout: a heading with the average score pinned beside the review list

sections.label: You may also like
sections.intent: Related products to keep the shopper in the catalogue.
sections.layout: horizontal scroller with the next card peeking

pages.label: Cart
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Free delivery meter
sections.intent: Shows how far the cart is from free delivery, in plain monospace numbers.
sections.layout: a slim full-width band

sections.label: Your cart
sections.intent: Cart lines beside the summary, coupon box, trust badges and checkout button. An empty cart shows a friendly nudge back to shopping instead.
sections.layout: lines left, a sticky boxed summary right

sections.label: Add before checkout
sections.intent: Small add-ons that tip the cart over the free delivery mark.
sections.layout: a horizontal scroller of cards

pages.label: Checkout
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Checkout
sections.intent: Contact, address, delivery options and the payment step in numbered boxed steps, with the order summary and coupon kept in view. The summary comes first on phones.
sections.layout: form steps left, a sticky order summary right

sections.label: Safe and supported
sections.intent: Secure payment, easy returns and help contacts, to calm last-step nerves.
sections.layout: a quiet centred band with three columns

pages.label: About
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Who we are
sections.intent: A typographic opening: the store name and founding year set large, with one warm line on why it exists.
sections.layout: oversized monospace headline over a thick rule

sections.label: Our story
sections.intent: How the store started and how it picks what it sells, in words beside a picture.
sections.layout: a split with the picture bleeding off the edge

sections.label: What shoppers say
sections.intent: Reviews from customers around India, so the store's claims carry weight.
sections.layout: three equal columns with thin dividers

sections.label: Start shopping
sections.intent: A closing nudge to the categories.
sections.layout: a band in the brand colour with light text and category links

pages.label: Contact
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Reach us
sections.intent: Phone, email, WhatsApp and address, each in its own boxed tile with an icon, so shoppers pick their channel.
sections.layout: bento grid with one large WhatsApp tile

sections.label: Common questions
sections.intent: Answers on delivery times, returns, COD and order tracking, to save a call.
sections.layout: a heading pinned beside the accordion

pages.label: All categories
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: All categories
sections.intent: Every category from <AllCategories> as large boxed picture tiles with their subcategories and product counts, under breadcrumbs and a big heading.
sections.layout: a centred heading over a mosaic with one large tile

sections.label: Browse everything
sections.intent: An invitation to see every product at once.
sections.layout: a slim band in the brand colour with light text

pages.label: All brands
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: All brands
sections.intent: Featured brands from <AllBrands> large first, then every brand as a dense bordered logo wall, under breadcrumbs and a heading.
sections.layout: a heading pinned beside the logo wall

sections.label: Browse everything
sections.intent: A link through to the full catalogue for shoppers who are not brand-loyal.
sections.layout: an edge-to-edge marquee strip of the call to action

pages.label: Footer
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Store footer
sections.intent: The store line set large in monospace beside link columns for shop, help, policies and company, with social links and newsletter signup in a bottom bar.
sections.layout: a large brand line beside the link columns, over a thick-ruled bottom bar

pages.label: Sign in
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Sign-in split
sections.intent: Sign-in split: a brand panel in the store colours with a warm welcome back and two or three short reasons to sign in (orders and returns in one place, saved addresses for a quicker checkout) beside <SignInForm />
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

sections.label: Reassurance strip
sections.intent: Reassurance strip: a secure sign-in with a one-time code, orders and returns in one place, saved addresses, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: on a band in the brand colour with light text

pages.label: Sign up
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Centred join
sections.intent: Centred join: a short invitation in the store voice over <SignUpForm /> on a softly tinted band
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

sections.label: What an account gives
sections.intent: What an account gives: orders in one place, saved addresses, a wishlist, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Account pages
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Account frame
sections.intent: Account frame: a slim welcome band in the store voice (never a name), then <AccountPage /> full width under it
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

sections.label: Help band
sections.intent: Help band: where to get help with an order, returns and the policies, as a few quiet links (/support, /return-policy, /legal)
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Order details
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Order page
sections.intent: Order page: a slim band with a link back to all orders (/account/orders), then <OrderDetail /> full width
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

sections.label: Help with this order
sections.intent: Help with this order: contact options from <Store> and links to returns (/return-policy) and support (/support)
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

pages.label: Wishlist
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Wishlist
sections.intent: Wishlist: a quiet title strip with the h1 and a short line, then <WishlistGrid /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: More to love
sections.intent: More to love: best sellers from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Compare
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Compare
sections.intent: Compare: a quiet title strip with the h1, then <CompareTable /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Help choosing
sections.intent: Help choosing: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

pages.label: Policies
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Policies
sections.intent: Policies: <LegalContent /> full width on a calm surface under a thin rule
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Questions
sections.intent: Questions: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Returns
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Returns
sections.intent: Returns: a clear heading band (the page’s h1) with a short reassuring line that makes no promise, then <ReturnsContent /> full width
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

sections.label: Still need help
sections.intent: Still need help: contact options from <Store> and a link to support (/support)
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Help and support
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Help centre
sections.intent: Help centre: a tinted band with the h1 and a short line, then <SupportContent /> full width
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

sections.label: Call or message
sections.intent: Call or message: a closing band inviting a call or a WhatsApp message through <Store>
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Page not found
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Lost page
sections.intent: Lost page: an oversized 404 in the store’s type and a friendly line in the store voice (the h1), with <NotFoundContent /> under it
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: New in
sections.intent: New in: the newest products from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: calm, with thin rules between the parts
